list.name: ds_dw
list.label: SCOM Data Warehouse
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the OperationsManagerDW database. Chosen automatically if its name contains "Warehouse" or "DW"; otherwise pick it here.

list.definition:
SELECT e.DisplayName AS __text, e.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
ORDER BY e.DisplayName
list.label: Server
list.name: server
list.query:
SELECT e.DisplayName AS __text, e.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
ORDER BY e.DisplayName

title: Insights - Trends

panels.description: By severity, for the selected servers. Is the estate getting noisier?

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  WHERE e.ManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT id FROM srv) OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT id FROM srv) OR e.DisplayName IN (SELECT name FROM srv)
)
SELECT CAST(CAST(a.RaisedDateTime AS date) AS datetime) AS time,
       CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS value
FROM Alert.vAlert a
JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY CAST(a.RaisedDateTime AS date), CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Alerts raised per day

panels.description: Roll-up monitors left out. A rising line is an early sign the estate is getting less healthy.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(CAST(r.DateTime AS date) AS datetime) AS time, 'Monitors that went Critical' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM State.vStateRaw r
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = r.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = em.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE r.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.NewHealthState = 3 AND r.OldHealthState <> 3
  AND mo.MonitorSystemName NOT IN ('System.Health.EntityState', 'System.Health.AvailabilityState', 'System.Health.ConfigurationState', 'System.Health.PerformanceState', 'System.Health.SecurityState')
  AND (e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId FROM dbo.vManagedEntity s WHERE s.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})) OR e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))
GROUP BY CAST(r.DateTime AS date)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monitors that went Critical per day

panels.description: Closed alerts, by the day they were raised. A rising line means alerts take longer to deal with.

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  WHERE e.ManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT id FROM srv) OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT id FROM srv) OR e.DisplayName IN (SELECT name FROM srv)
)
SELECT y.time, y.metric, y.value FROM (
  SELECT CAST(CAST(a.RaisedDateTime AS date) AS datetime) AS time, 'Average minutes to resolve' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(rs.TimeFromRaisedSeconds) / 60.0, 1) AS value
  FROM Alert.vAlert a
  JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = a.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN Alert.vAlertResolutionState rs ON rs.AlertGuid = a.AlertGuid AND rs.ResolutionState = 255
  WHERE a.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY CAST(a.RaisedDateTime AS date)
) y
ORDER BY y.time

panels.title: Average minutes to resolve alerts

panels.description: Daily average across the selected servers. The previous period of the same length is shifted forward to overlap.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS server, CAST(p.DateTime AS date) AS dy, AVG(p.AverageValue) AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfDaily p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = 'Processor Information|% Processor Time'
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -2 * DATEDIFF(day, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()), $__timeFrom()) AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY h.DisplayName, CAST(p.DateTime AS date)
)
SELECT y.time, y.metric, y.value FROM (
  SELECT CAST(s.dy AS datetime) AS time, 'This period' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(s.v), 2) AS value FROM sel s
  WHERE s.dy >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS date) GROUP BY s.dy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATEADD(day, DATEDIFF(day, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()), CAST(s.dy AS datetime)), 'Previous period', ROUND(AVG(s.v), 2) FROM sel s
  WHERE s.dy < CAST($__timeFrom() AS date) GROUP BY s.dy
) y
ORDER BY y.time

panels.title: CPU: this period against the previous one

panels.description: Daily average across the selected servers. The previous period of the same length is shifted forward to overlap.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS server, CAST(p.DateTime AS date) AS dy, AVG(p.AverageValue) AS v
  FROM Perf.vPerfDaily p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE h.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}) AND i.InstanceName IN ('_Total', '')
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = 'Memory|PercentMemoryUsed'
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN DATEADD(day, -2 * DATEDIFF(day, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()), $__timeFrom()) AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY h.DisplayName, CAST(p.DateTime AS date)
)
SELECT y.time, y.metric, y.value FROM (
  SELECT CAST(s.dy AS datetime) AS time, 'This period' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(s.v), 2) AS value FROM sel s
  WHERE s.dy >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS date) GROUP BY s.dy
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATEADD(day, DATEDIFF(day, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()), CAST(s.dy AS datetime)), 'Previous period', ROUND(AVG(s.v), 2) FROM sel s
  WHERE s.dy < CAST($__timeFrom() AS date) GROUP BY s.dy
) y
ORDER BY y.time

panels.title: Memory: this period against the previous one

panels.description: The 25 alerts raised most often in the time range, with how long they take to resolve. Tune or fix the top entries first.

targets.rawSql:
WITH srv AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId AS id, e.DisplayName AS name
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId AND t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName = 'Microsoft.Windows.Computer'
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})
),
ent AS (
  SELECT e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
  WHERE e.ManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT id FROM srv) OR e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT id FROM srv) OR e.DisplayName IN (SELECT name FROM srv)
),
a AS (
  SELECT al.AlertGuid, al.AlertName, al.Severity, al.RaisedDateTime, en.ManagedEntityRowId, al.RepeatCount,
         (SELECT TOP 1 rs.TimeFromRaisedSeconds FROM Alert.vAlertResolutionState rs WHERE rs.AlertGuid = al.AlertGuid AND rs.ResolutionState = 255) AS secs_to_close
  FROM Alert.vAlert al JOIN ent en ON en.ManagedEntityRowId = al.ManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE al.RaisedDateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT TOP 25 a.AlertName AS Alert,
       MAX(a.Severity) AS Severity,
       COUNT(*) AS Raised,
       SUM(CAST(a.RepeatCount AS bigint)) AS "Repeat count",
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.ManagedEntityRowId) AS Sources,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(a.RaisedDateTime AS date)) AS "Days seen",
       MIN(a.RaisedDateTime) AS "First seen",
       MAX(a.RaisedDateTime) AS "Last seen",
       ROUND(AVG(a.secs_to_close) / 60.0, 0) AS "Average minutes to resolve",
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.secs_to_close IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Still open"
FROM a
GROUP BY a.AlertName
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.AlertName

panels.title: Alerts raised most often

panels.description: Monitors with the most state changes in the range, with how many objects they affect. Many changes per object means a monitor that flips back and forth: tune it first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 25 mo.MonitorDefaultName AS Monitor,
       COUNT(*) AS "State changes",
       COUNT(DISTINCT em.ManagedEntityRowId) AS Objects,
       ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT em.ManagedEntityRowId), 0), 1) AS "Changes per object",
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.NewHealthState = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Went critical",
       MAX(r.DateTime) AS "Last change"
FROM State.vStateRaw r
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = r.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = em.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE r.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND r.OldHealthState <> 0
  AND mo.MonitorSystemName NOT IN ('System.Health.EntityState', 'System.Health.AvailabilityState', 'System.Health.ConfigurationState', 'System.Health.PerformanceState', 'System.Health.SecurityState')
  AND (e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId IN (SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId FROM dbo.vManagedEntity s WHERE s.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote})) OR e.DisplayName IN (${server:singlequote}))
GROUP BY mo.MonitorDefaultName
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, mo.MonitorDefaultName

panels.title: Monitors that change state most often (flapping)

description: How the estate is changing: alerts per day, monitors going critical, time to resolve, load against the previous period, the most frequent alerts and the monitors that flap.
